stem.en: Why is the stratosphere ideal for flying aeroplanes?

text.en: Its air is warmer than the air at the ground.
Its air is denser than the air below it.
It is free of clouds and other weather disturbances.
It holds most of the oxygen in the air.

explanation.en: Clouds, storms and nearly all other weather stay in the troposphere below, so the air in the stratosphere gives a smooth flight. Its air is thinner and colder than the air at the ground, and most of the oxygen lies lower down.

hints.en: Think about what a pilot wants to stay away from.
